name: Kirill Ilyich Leonov
original_name: キリル・イリイチ・レオノフ
source:
Star Sign: Gemini

A youth who is trying to run away from this turbulent era.
He's from a soviet nation and doing guerrilla actions in Germany.
There he has an impressive meeting with the protagonist...
